server.name: Twinbay
server.title: Twinbay API Digital Twins
server.description: Create API test environments from behavioral twins, seed their starting state, inspect requests from code under test, and evaluate the results against reusable tests.

protocolMetadata.instructions:
Twinbay runs behavioural twins of third-party APIs. Pick a twin with
`list_twins`, describe what it should already hold with `create_seed` if an empty
twin is not enough, put it in an environment with `create_environment`, wait for
it with `get_environment_twin` and `wait_for=ready`, collect its key with
`collect_environment_twin_credential`, point the code under test at the twin's URL,
then read back what it sent with `list_request_logs` and `get_request_log`.
Save reusable provider and seed selections with `create_scenario`, manage them
with `list_scenarios`, `get_scenario`, `update_scenario` and `delete_scenario`,
and pass a scenario's id as `scenario` to `create_environment`.

To grade what the code under test did, describe its outcomes with `create_test`
and revise them with `update_test`; each update appends an immutable version.
Create an evaluator for the test and twins with `create_evaluator`; omit
`test_version` for the latest definition or supply it to pin an earlier one.
Compilation is asynchronous: poll `get_evaluator` until `status` is `ready`, or
`error` with a structured `last_error`. `create_test_run` opens an attempt on an
existing environment using that evaluator; only traffic served after that counts,
and an environment runs one attempt at a time. `create_evaluation` with the run
and `phase=checkpoint` grades the attempt so far and keeps it open;
`phase=final` closes it. Pass an `Idempotency-Key` so a retried call returns the
same evaluation. Evaluation is asynchronous too: poll `get_evaluation` until
`status` is `completed` or `error`. Only a `passed` verdict is a pass;
`inconclusive` means an outcome is not settled, because the attempt is still
open or `coverage_status` is not `complete`. To regrade the same capture, call
`create_evaluation` again for the same run and phase with another ready
`evaluator_id` compiled for the run's pinned test version.
`download_evaluation_input` signs a link to that capture.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Twinbay API Digital Twins to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Twinbay API Digital Twins to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.twinbay.ai/mcp.
